newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle light at $103.50/dressed- USDA.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle light at $103.50/dressed- USDA.

text.p: Slaughter steers and heifers were not tested on a live basis, with dressed sales steady, USDA said. Buyer inquiry very strong and several scheduling some of today's purchases for Wednesday's kill.
Many sellers not interested at current bids, and pricing cattle at $104.00 per cwt on a dressed basis.
Live basis sales - Equivalent 3 percent shrink delivered and FOB, some FOB 4% shrink. Dressed basis delivered ( paid on hot carcass weights).
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1225-1300 lbs 103.00-103.50. Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1075-1200 lbs 103.00-103.50. Confirmed - 1,500 For the week - 6,800
